name: Camping "Ferienpark Hainz am See"
beschreibung: Campingplatz Ferienpark Hainz am See is situated in Petting in Tyrol and is classified as a campsite. It lies directly on the shores of a swimming lake, which is one of the campsite's highlight features. The pitches are parcelled and partially equipped with electricity and water hookups. A separate beach area with a playground lawn is reserved for guests. The surrounding forested area is ideal for cycling tours and walks. The sanitary facilities are cleaned regularly and offer barrier-free access.
